mapper.select: SELECT id, connection_id, offering_key, model_key, enabled, default_access, sort_order FROM pw_platform_ai_offering WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, connection_id, offering_key, model_key, enabled, default_access, sort_order FROM pw_platform_ai_offering WHERE offering_key = #{offeringKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: SELECT o.id AS offering_id, o.offering_key, o.model_key, o.enabled AS offering_enabled, o.default_access, o.sort_order AS offering_sort_order, c.id AS connection_id, c.connection_key, c.kind, c.protocol, c.cli_key, c.config ->> 'baseUrl' AS base_url, c.credentials_configured, c.enabled AS connection_enabled, c.sort_order AS connection_sort_order FROM pw_platform_ai_offering o JOIN pw_platform_ai_connection c ON c.id = o.connection_id LEFT JOIN pw_platform_ai_user_access a ON a.offering_id = o.id AND a.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.enabled = 1 AND o.enabled = 1 AND COALESCE(a.enabled, o.default_access) = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pw_platform_ai_offering (connection_id, offering_key, model_key, enabled, default_access, sort_order) VALUES (#{connectionId}, #{offeringKey}, #{modelKey}, CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{defaultAccess} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE pw_platform_ai_offering SET enabled = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} AND model_key IS NULL
